name: Academy Practice Play-Through (64 missions × 13 languages)
greenMarker: Every academy practice plays correctly in every language
note: Gate 2-5 proves each practice's answer follows from its board data. This gate proves the screen: the drawn board, the prompt, and what tapping does. Each mutation breaks one of those while leaving the data — and therefore gate 2-5 — untouched.

mutations.name: a wrong digit is accepted silently
mutations.why: If the error state is never set, a wrong tap does nothing visible and the player cannot tell a miss from a missed tap. Data-level checks cannot see this; only playing it can.

mutations.name: a which-candidate-goes mission shows the ordinary prompt
mutations.why: The prompt tells the player what to enter. Showing "enter the number for the empty cell" on a mission that asks which candidate is removed makes the correct answer look wrong.

mutations.name: the full-board layout falls back to a 3x3 box
mutations.why: Without its own branch a 9x9 example renders through the default 3-column box grid: 81 cells in 27 rows, a board no player could read. The cell count is unchanged, so only the drawn width catches it — the fallback grid is narrower, so the check is that a 9x9 mission is drawn nine cells wide.

mutations.name: academy boards mirror in Arabic again
mutations.why: Found on 2026-09-18: the page is dir=rtl in Arabic and the academy grids were not on the left-to-right list the game board uses, so r1c1 drew on the right while every guide names cells counted from the left.

mutations.name: struck-out candidates go back to red on a faint tint
mutations.why: Found on 2026-09-18: red text on a light red wash measured 2.7:1 on every theme — under the 3:1 a 9px struck-out candidate needs.
